item.tib: byams ma'i las tshogs lha mo lcags kyu ma'i char 'beb kyi sgom bzlas rim pa gzhan phan rgya mtsho
item.coloph: de ltar byams ma'i las tshogs lha mo lcags kyu ma'i/ bsgom bzlas rim pa mdo tsam bsgrigs pa 'di/ gzhan phan blo yis legs bskul nyi ming pas/ gong ma'i sgrub gnas gnam thos zhes pas (par) brtsams/ dge bas bstan 'gro'i don cher nus byed shog/
